calls.description: the calls that went out through a `uses` link (@yaks/connections) in one month, each with the link's credential in place of its sentinel: what the link's cap is measured against. Only the egress counts them, and a new month starts the count over

month.description: the UTC month it counts, as YYYY-MM

count.description: how many calls went out through the link that month

called.description: an event: one call just went out through this `uses` link. The graph adds it to the link's `calls` inside the write's own transaction, so two at once both count, and never stores it

month.description: the UTC month the call went out in, as YYYY-MM
